item.title: Quickselect
item.description: Quickselect is an algorithm that finds the k-th smallest element in a sequence of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Fast Cantor Expansion
item.description: The Fast Cantor Expansion is an algorithm that finds the lexicographical rank of a permutation p_0,p_1,\dots,p_{n-1} of \{0,1,\dots,n-1\} among all permutations of \{0,1,\dots,n-1\} in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Inverse Fast Cantor Expansion
item.description: The Inverse Fast Cantor Expansion is an algorithm that finds the k-th lexicographically smallest permutation of \{0,1,\dots,n-1\} in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Bellman-Ford Algorithm
item.description: The Bellman-Ford Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the length of the shortest path from a vertex s to every vertex in a directed graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with edge weights and no negative cycles in \mathcal{O}(|V||E|) time and \mathcal{O}(|V|) space.

item.title: Borůvka's Algorithm
item.description: Borůvka’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the weight of the minimum spanning tree of a connected undirected graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with edge weights in \mathcal{O}(|E|\log|V|) time and \mathcal{O}(|E|) space.

item.title: Dijkstra's Algorithm
item.description: Dijkstra’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the length of the shortest path from a vertex s to every vertex in a directed graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with non-negative edge weights in \mathcal{O}(|V|^2+|E|) time and \mathcal{O}(|V|+|E|) space, or \mathcal{O}((|V|+|E|)\log|E|) time and \mathcal...

item.title: Prim's Algorithm
item.description: Prim’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the weight of the minimum spanning tree of a connected undirected graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with edge weights in \mathcal{O}(|V|^2+|E|) time and \mathcal{O}(|E|) space, or \mathcal{O}(|E|\log|E|) time and \mathcal{O}(|E|) space.

item.title: Aho-Corasick Automaton
item.description: The Aho-Corasick Automaton is a data structure that maintains a set S of strings in \Sigma^* by maintaining a deterministic finite automaton that accepts and only accepts strings containing a string from S as a suffix.

item.title: Bluestein's Algorithm
item.description: Bluestein’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes f(z^0),f(z^1),\dots,f(z^{m-1}) for a polynomial f(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}a_ix^i in \mathcal{O}((n+m)\log(n+m)) time and \mathcal{O}(n+m) space.
